title: Exactness and countable products for the localized scalar cone
statement: For a ring R, an R-linear abelian category A with a derived category, and s : R, the localized functor obtained by sending a complex to the coimage cone of scalar multiplication by s has a commutative shift structure, is triangulated, and preserves limits of shape Discrete ℕ. Here the localized functor is [def-coef-linear-scalar-cone].

proof.text: Construct the scalar cocone functor using the existing signed mapping-cocone construction. Transpose its two Hom-complex coordinates to the scalar cone coordinates. The cocycle relations follow from centrality of scalar composition, and both transpose composites and their naturality are checked on the two projections. This gives cocone(s) left adjoint to cone(s). Localize the adjunction using the canonical comparison and its shifted version; hence the derived scalar cone preserves every existing countable product.

Apply the proved signed cocone shift coherence to scalar multiplication between two identity functors. Compose with the triangulated shift by one and transport across cocone(s)[1] isomorphic to cone(s). Localize this coherent shift structure along Q using the fixed comparison.

For a chain map f, form the degreewise four-coordinate permutation from cone(s on cone(f)) to cone(cone(s on f)): (a,b,c,d) maps to (-a,c,b,d). The same permutation is its inverse. Check that it commutes with the differentials, the cone inclusion and the negative cone boundary with the transported signed shift. This gives an isomorphism of mapping-cone triangles. Every distinguished derived triangle is isomorphic to Q of a mapping-cone triangle; the localization comparison and this triangle isomorphism therefore prove preservation of distinguished triangles. Combine this with the coherent shifts and right-adjoint product preservation.

lean.statement:
theorem exact_products
    {R : Type r} [Ring R] {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [Linear R A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] (s : R) :
    ∃ h : (derived (A := A) s).CommShift ℤ,
      letI := h
      (derived (A := A) s).IsTriangulated ∧
      PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) (derived (A := A) s)
